sentences.text: BTS , also known as Bangtan Boys , is a seven-member South Korean boy band formed by Big Hit Entertainment .	Big Hit Entertainment	Big Hit Entertainment	boy band	boy band	Korean	Korean language
Their name in Korean - Bangtan Sonyeondan , and Japanese - , both translate to `` Bulletproof Boy Scouts '' .	Korean	Korean language

They debuted on June 13 , 2013 , with the song `` No More Dream '' from their first album called 2 Cool 4 Skool , for which they won several `` New Artist of the Year '' awards including those at the 2013 MelOn Music Awards and Golden Disk Awards , and the 2014 Seoul Music Awards .	Seoul	Seoul	MelOn Music Awards	MelOn Music Awards	Golden Disk Awards	Golden Disk Awards	Seoul Music Awards	Seoul Music Awards
A year after their debut , they received major bonsang awards for their subsequent albums Dark & Wild and The Most Beautiful Moment in Life , Part 1 .	bonsang	bonsang	Dark & Wild	Dark & Wild

BTS continued rising to widespread prominence with their The Most Beautiful Moment in Life trilogy , with The Most Beautiful Moment in Life , Part 2 and The Most Beautiful Moment In Life : Young Forever both debuting inside the Billboard 200 .	Billboard	Billboard charts

The Most Beautiful Moment In Life , Part 2 also charted at number one on the Billboard World Albums Chart and remained there for multiple weeks , making BTS the first K-pop act to achieve that feat .	K-pop	K-pop	pop	pop music	Billboard	Billboard charts
The Most Beautiful Moment in Life : Young Forever went on to win the coveted `` Album of the Year '' award at the 2016 Melon Music Awards .	Melon Music Awards	Melon Music Awards
This win marked BTS 's first daesang , or `` grand prize '' , since their debut .	daesang	daesang
The group released their second full album , Wings in 2016 .	Wings	Wings (BTS album)

The album debuted at # 26 on the US Billboard 200 , which marked the highest chart ranking for a K-pop album ever , as well as made BTS the first K-pop act to log three entries onto the chart , and the first to spend more than one week on the chart .	K-pop	K-pop	pop	pop music	Billboard	Billboard charts

In their native South Korea , Wings sold 681,924 albums in its first month , breaking the record for the highest first month sale for an album in Gaon history , as well as becoming the best selling album in Gaon history thus far .	South Korea	South Korea	Wings	Wings (BTS album)	Gaon	Gaon Music Chart

The album 's title track , `` Blood Sweat & Tears '' -LRB- Korean : 피 땀 눈물 -RRB- , became the group 's first domestic number one hit on the Gaon Digital Chart .	Gaon	Gaon Music Chart	Korean	Korean language	Gaon Digital Chart	Gaon Digital Chart

The group 's follow up comeback and follow up title song , ` Spring Day ' -LRB- Korean : 봄날 -RRB- also reached number one on Gaon Digital Chart , and its corresponding album ` You Never Walk Alone ' recorded over 700,000 in pre-orders alone .	Gaon	Gaon Music Chart	Korean	Korean language	Gaon Digital Chart	Gaon Digital Chart	You Never Walk Alone	You Never Walk Alone
Wings went on to sell more than 1.5 million copies , making it BTS 's first `` million seller '' .	Wings	Wings (BTS album)
To date , BTS 's discography has sold an estimated 4 million albums worldwide .
Known for their large social media presence , BTS were listed by Forbes as the most retweeted artist on Twitter in March 2016 .	Forbes	Forbes	Twitter	Twitter
Following that , Twitter launched its first ever K-pop Twitter emoji featuring BTS .	K-pop	K-pop	pop	pop music	Twitter	Twitter
In October 2016 , Billboard placed BTS as # 1 on their Social 50 chart , making them the first Korean group to top the chart .	Billboard	Billboard charts	Korean	Korean language	Social 50	Social 50
To date , they have spent 27 weeks as # 1 on the Social 50 chart .	Social 50	Social 50
In 2017 , BTS won a Billboard Music Award for ` Top Social Artist ' .	Billboard	Billboard charts	Billboard Music Award	Billboard Music Award

Also known for their large international fanbase , having performed and sold out tours in Asia , Europe , Australia , North America and South America , BTS 's performances won them the Best World Performer award in the 2015 Mnet Asian Music Awards .	Asia	Asia	Europe	Europe	Australia	Australia	North America	North America	South America	South America	Mnet Asian Music Awards	Mnet Asian Music Awards
Just a year later , BTS went on to win the 2016 Mnet Asian Music Award for Artist of the Year .	Mnet Asian Music Award for Artist of the Year	Mnet Asian Music Award for Artist of the Year
In 2017 , BTS ranked # 5 on Forbes Korea Power Celebrity list , a list ranking Korea 's most powerful and influential celebrities .	Forbes	Forbes	Korea Power Celebrity	Forbes Korea Power Celebrity
